title: Automatic PR review and technical architecture maps
intent: Make a short NavoCode PR review request open an interactive workspace and show responsibilities and contracts at senior engineering depth.

groups.title: Automatic interactive PR review
groups.summary: Select one applicable change, open reviewer mode and enter feedback listening from a short review request.

groups.title: Technical architecture review
groups.summary: Show internal responsibility boundaries, dependency direction and complete interaction contracts without mapping every helper.

components.name: Host review skill
components.current: Review instructions require agents to assemble prepare/start/listen steps.
components.intended: Interpret a short PR review request as fetch, select, open and listen. Infer architectural boundaries from inspected source.
components.observed: Updated skill makes the full review loop the default and defines handling for inferred or ambiguous specs.

components.name: Review CLI orchestration
components.current: Prepare a temporary PR checkout and return context only.
components.intended: Start a reviewer session after successful preparation; return session and authenticated URL. Allow prepare-only for context tooling.
components.observed: CLI review starts review mode by default; ambiguous/missing specs return context without opening an incorrect workspace.

components.name: GitHub review adapter
components.current: Fetch the exact PR head; require manual selection whenever multiple specs exist.
components.intended: Select the only fresh spec covering PR changes. Preserve exact-head binding and immutable baseline.
components.observed: Candidate inspection rejects stale or incomplete specs from automatic selection and preserves explicit change overrides.

components.name: Spec validator and source binding
components.current: Validate schema, source digest, changed-file coverage and evidence freshness.
components.intended: Own schema and source-binding checks used to determine candidate applicability.
components.observed: Existing core.inspect and assert_spec are reused; acceptance records and freshness contracts are unchanged.

components.name: Local HTTP feedback server
components.current: Serve authenticated state, revision-bound feedback and agent acknowledgements.
components.intended: Own live session state and pending feedback; persist no hosted state.
components.observed: Existing loopback token-authenticated server serves the same reviewer session launched by CLI start.

components.name: Browser architecture renderer
components.current: Render names in a fixed two-column grid with truncated relation labels.
components.intended: Lay out dependency layers, collapse cycles for ranking, show responsibilities and complete numbered boundary contracts.
components.observed: SVG renders wrapped component text, directional routed edges and a full contract list. Before/Intended filters and contextual discussion remain available.

components.name: Spec and review baseline files
components.current: Store architectural intent, evidence and original PR baseline in JSON.
components.intended: Remain the source of truth for architecture; temporary spec edits remain separate from original PR code.
components.observed: Review still writes baseline/context to a temporary directory and reads spec revisions for proposal comparison.

gh API and Git fetch: exact PR head, base and candidate specs

decisions.title: Default review interaction
decisions.choice: A short request to review a PR with NavoCode starts the full reviewer workspace and live feedback loop.
alternatives: Require explicit change, workspace-opening and listening instructions on every review.
consequences: The human can start review with a short request.
Ambiguous applicable changes still require a choice; no applicable spec requires an inferred draft.
An active host turn is required for feedback listening.

decisions.title: Technical diagram depth
decisions.choice: Show internal high-level components and boundary contracts at a level where senior engineers decide ownership and dependencies.
alternatives: Keep broad product-area nodes with generic links.
Create a node for every file or helper.
consequences: Specs must describe actual responsibility and contract boundaries based on source inspection.
Large maps use horizontal scrolling to preserve readable text; full contract labels remain in the list below.

evidence.claim: Automatic review defaults preserve revision-bound review behavior.
evidence.detail: npm run check passed JavaScript syntax checks and 34 Python runtime tests, including fresh candidate selection over historical/incomplete specs and default session startup versus prepare-only.

evidence.claim: Technical maps retain interaction, safe rendering and mobile containment.
evidence.detail: npm run test:browser passed 2 Chromium tests, including cyclic and self-loop relations, an isolated component, complete long contract text, Before/Intended relation filtering, feedback context and mobile width.

evidence.claim: The requested defaults and architecture depth are represented in the skill, CLI and browser.
evidence.detail: Inspected candidate inspection, CLI startup, authenticated session transport and SVG renderer. Human instruction in this session explicitly requested automatic PR review and internal high-level architecture at senior-engineering depth.

acceptanceCriteria: A short review request opens reviewer mode and enters the feedback loop without repeated instructions.
A single applicable spec is chosen even when historical specs exist.
Ambiguous candidates never silently select an unrelated spec.
Architecture shows component responsibilities and full directional boundary contracts.
Cycles, isolated components and Before/Intended views render safely at mobile and desktop widths.
nonGoals: Publishing review proposals without human request.
Changing PR source when reviewing it.
Mapping every file or helper as a component.
